The uniform timeline is workbench preview metadata for the raw returned image; under the actual adapter it selects a different frame at 10 of 11 evaluated times, shortens the rest from 800 ms to 100 ms and repeats the pulse every 500 ms, contradicting the brief's 'occasional idle signal'. transfer_decisions.reason: Preview durations reported by the pixelart_workbench inspect text for the raw returned image; not an owner requirement, not what the adapter or captures use, and contradicted by the method's own pitfall. Caller agrees with the specialist.

CF-09 forbids camera movement and moving contact and requires nearest sampling and the minimal two-colour, fully opaque treatment; the delivered frames have zero fractional-alpha pixels. Nothing in that slice transfers. Caller agrees.
